title: 2026 engagement survey results
brief: People Ops at Hollow Creek Software ran the 2026 engagement survey (closed 2026-09-26) and needs a results page. 412 of 474 employees responded. Show three tiles: Response rate 87 percent, Overall engagement 74 percent favorable, eNPS 31. Section titled "Results by question": a bar chart comparing percent favorable in 2025 vs 2026 for each question: "I understand our strategy" 2025 61, 2026 72; "My manager supports my growth" 70 and 76; "I have the tools to do my job" 64 and 59; "Workload is sustainable" 52 and 48; "I would recommend working here" 73 and 79; "Decisions are communicated well" 49 and 58. Section titled "By department": a table with columns Department, Responses, Response rate, Engagement: Engineering, 168, 89 percent, 71 percent; Sales, 92, 81 percent, 77 percent; Support, 74, 90 percent, 69 percent; Operations, 48, 86 percent, 80 percent; G&A, 30, 88 percent, 83 percent. Section titled "Focus areas": a bulleted list naming the two declines, tools and workload, plus a callout noting that Support has the lowest engagement and a listening session is set for 2026-10-28. Keep comments anonymous: do not quote any individual responses.

edit.request: Add the question "I feel safe raising concerns" to the chart with 66 in 2025 and 71 in 2026.
